columns.description: A five-digit identifying number for each agency used in the current NTD system.

columns.description: The legal name of the entity reporting to the NTD.
columns.name: Agency

columns.description: A 2000 character field used to describe the details of the event.
columns.name: Incident Description

columns.description: Abbreviation of mode. For a complete list of modes, please find the most current Safety and Security Policy Manual at https://www.transit.dot.gov/ntd/manuals
columns.name: Mode

columns.description: Abbreviation for "Type of Service." Describes how public transportation services are provided by the transit agency: directly operated (DO) or purchased transportation which also includes from Taxi Operators and Transportation Network Companies (PT, TX, TN) services.
columns.name: TOS

columns.description: Groups modes based on whether they are: Rail Running Non-Rail Surface Transportation Ferryboat
columns.name: Rail/Bus/Ferry

columns.description: Identifies whether the Mode reported is operating on a fixed route.
columns.name: Fixed Route Flag

columns.description: The calendar year in which the event occurred.
columns.name: Year

columns.description: A unique system-generated identification number for each Major Safety Event.
columns.name: Incident Number

columns.description: The date on which the event occurred.
columns.name: Incident Date

columns.description: The actual time of day the event occurred.
columns.name: Incident Time

columns.description: The type of event that occurred. Collision with person events are transformed from a collision type based on the following circumstances: “Attempted Suicide” if the person survives or “Suicide”, if they pass away. Collision with person events where the person was pushed in front of an oncoming transit vehicle is [Assault or Homicide] on [person type]. Derailment events are transformed to “Yard Derailment” or “Main Line Derailment” based on location of derailment. Non-transit collisions involving non-revenue property (events where agency property other than revenue vehicles were involved) are transformed to “Other”.
columns.name: Event Type

columns.description: Identifier of events involving a runaway train.  [A train which is no longer under the control of a driver regardless of whether the operator is physically on the vehicle at the time. This is limited to revenue vehicles.]
columns.name: Runaway Train Flag

columns.description: Identifier of a Safety (SFT) or (Security Event). [Safety Event: A collision, derailment, fire, hazardous material spill, act of nature (Act of God), evacuation, or OSONOC occurring on transit right-of-way, in a transit revenue facility, in a transit maintenance facility, or involving a transit revenue vehicle and meeting established NTD thresholds.] OR [Security event: An occurrence of a bomb threat, bombing, arson, hijacking, sabotage, cyber security event, assault, robbery, rape, burglary, suicide, attempted suicide (not involving a transit vehicle), larceny, theft, vandalism, homicide, CBR (chemical/biological/radiological) or nuclear release, or other event.]
columns.name: Safety/Security

columns.description: Identifies what the transit vehicle collided with: Motor Vehicle, Non-Transit Motor Vehicle, Non-Rail Transit Vehicle, Rail Transit Vehicle/Rail Passenger Train – Revenue Service, Rail Transit Vehicle/Rail Passenger Train – Not in Revenue Service, Rail Transit Vehicle/Rail Transit Maintenance or Service Vehicle on the rail fixed guideway, Person, Animal, Fixed Object, Transit vehicle, Vessel, Dock/Terminal center, Non-revenue vehicle, Other.
columns.name: Collision With

columns.description: Non-rail mode: The estimated dollar value of all property that is damaged in a Reportable Event. This includes transit-owned property and other vehicles and property involved in the event that are not owned by the transit agency (excludes personal property such as cell phones and computers). Property damage also includes the cost of clearing wreckage.
columns.name: Property Damage

description: This file includes event data reported to the National Transit Database (NTD) for Commuter Rail (CR) and Alaska Railroad (AR) modes, as well as Heavy Rail (HR) service reported for Port Authority Trans Hudson (NTD ID: 20098), Hybrid Rail (YR) service for the Tri-County Metropolitan Transportation District of Oregon (NTD ID: 00008),  Hybrid Rail (YR) service for Denton County Transportation Authority (NTD ID: 60101), and Hybrid Rail (YR) service for Capital Metropolitan Transportation Authority (NTD ID: 60048). Because these services fall under the safety oversight of the Federal Railroad Administration, the agencies are not required to report Safety Events (e.g., collisions, derailments, etc.) to the Federal Transit Administration through the NTD. Security events occurring on transit-owned property for these entities are reported to NTD, but excluded from other files to preserve the integrity of those datasets. They are presented in this file for completeness and should be considered by any user attempting to understand the scope and scale of reportable Security Events reported by public transit operators.
name: FRA Regulated Mode Major Security Events
